senses.meaning: Cuộc chạy nước rút; đoạn chạy hết tốc lực
examples: She won the 100m sprint at the national championships.
The race ended with a sprint to the finish line.
A sprint finish separated the top three runners.

senses.meaning: Chạy nước rút, chạy hết tốc lực
examples: He sprinted down the hallway to catch the bus.
The striker sprinted past two defenders to score.
She sprinted the last 200 metres of the race.

senses.meaning: Tốc độ, nhịp độ; một bước chân
examples: We walked at a brisk pace to keep warm.
The project is progressing at a steady pace.
She set the pace for the rest of the runners.

senses.meaning: Đi lại qua lại (lo lắng); điều chỉnh nhịp độ
examples: He paced back and forth nervously while waiting for the results.
She paced the room, unable to sleep.
The trainer paced the athletes through their warm-up routine.

note: 'Pace' trong thể thao chỉ tốc độ duy trì suốt cuộc đua, khác với 'sprint' (tốc độ tối đa ngắn hạn).
